params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box, column, header, or footer.

params.name: colPosition
params.description: Position the new column is inserted in front of; if greater than the total number of columns, the column is added last.

params.name: colName
params.description: Name of the new column object.

params.name: formula
params.description: 4D formula (instruction, Formula-editor formula, command call, or project method call) evaluated for the column's contents.

params.name: dataType
params.description: Type of the value produced by evaluating formula.

contentParam.name: headerName
contentParam.description: Name of the column header object.

bindingParam.name: headerVar
bindingParam.description: Column header variable (or a Nil pointer ->[] in a dynamic context).

params.description: Names and binds the inserted column's header object/variable.
Optional: names and binds the inserted column's footer object/variable.

overloads.semanticRole: Inserts a new formula-driven column, with its header and optional footer, into the designated list box.

constraints: Formula-driven columns require the list box's Data Source to be Current Selection, Named Selection, Collection, or Entity Selection.
Does nothing if applied to the first column of a list box displayed in hierarchical mode.
